diff --git a/src/requests/utils.py b/src/requests/utils.py
index e69ad0d7..62574397 100644
--- a/src/requests/utils.py
+++ b/src/requests/utils.py
@@ -836,6 +836,10 @@ def should_bypass_proxies(url: str, no_proxy: str | None) -> bool:
         # the end of the hostname, both with and without the port.
         no_proxy_hosts = (host for host in no_proxy.replace(" ", "").split(",") if host)
 
+        if no_proxy == "*":
+            # A no_proxy value of '*' means bypass the proxy for all hosts.
+            return True
+
         if is_ipv4_address(hostname):
             for proxy_ip in no_proxy_hosts:
                 if is_valid_cidr(proxy_ip):
@@ -851,7 +855,16 @@ def should_bypass_proxies(url: str, no_proxy: str | None) -> bool:
                 host_with_port += f":{parsed.port}"
 
             for host in no_proxy_hosts:
-                if hostname.endswith(host) or host_with_port.endswith(host):
+                if host.startswith("."):
+                    # Leading dots are only matched at the end of the hostname,
+                    # so they can be stripped from the no_proxy entry.
+                    host = host.lstrip(".")
+                if (
+                    hostname == host
+                    or host_with_port == host
+                    or hostname.endswith(f".{host}")
+                    or host_with_port.endswith(f".{host}")
+                ):
                     # The URL does match something in no_proxy, so we don't want
                     # to apply the proxies on this URL.
                     return True
